title: Bound latest-turn tail signature work during streaming
outcome: resolveLatestTurnTailSignature serializes every message since the latest resident user prompt from a layout effect on each streaming render. Long tool-heavy turns can therefore incur O(turn length) string work per delta. Memoize, incrementally fold, or otherwise bound the repeated signature computation without weakening live-tail transition detection.
acceptance: Streaming updates avoid rebuilding an O(turn length) JSON signature for unchanged historical messages, while tests preserve detection of insertion, replacement, and mutation within the latest turn and the no-resident-prompt fallback.
